chose: A clip's frames show one by one through TanStack Query's own experimental_streamedQuery over the reader as an async generator, each answer put in its frame's place (refetchMode append with a reducer by index), so a later visit keeps what showed until home answers again. A clip is kept for the page load once every frame is settled: a frame, or a session side's frame home doesn't hold; a walk's missing frame, home away, busy or unreadable is asked again on the next visit.
options: streamedQuery, answers placed by index over the last visit's
streamedQuery with refetchMode reset, which blanks the frames on each visit
streamedQuery with refetchMode replace, which shows nothing new until the whole clip is read
a runtime of our own over ports, as lib/call-videos has
gray: #2895 suggested a runtime over ports like lib/call-videos. TanStack's streamedQuery already streams an async iterable into the query's data, so no runtime of ours holds anything the query doesn't, but it is exported as experimental. Reset would make a visit's frames vanish and come back, against a screen holding still while it is used (HS1); replace would undo the item on every visit after the first.
undo: Make readClipFrames collect clipFrames again and drop streamedQuery from home.ts; settled stays.
